observations: Single photo shows a black PS4-style console lying on its side on a table, with two black DualShock-style controllers resting on top of it.
The console has a white decorative decal/skin on its top panel (appears to be a character graphic, possibly Batman-themed), partly obscured by a watermark reading 'SNYZ GADGET HOME'.
Shape and port layout are consistent with an original 'fat' PS4 model, not a Slim or Pro, but no model plate or serial sticker is visible or legible.
No rear or side panel shown, so HDMI/power/USB ports are not visible.
No photo of a power-on screen, game library, storage menu, or the claimed UK receipt.
No separate photo of the controllers' top/front (analog sticks, buttons) for condition check.
Seller's new message is text only, no new photo or video provided.

claims.claim: USA used ps4 console and pad
claims.evidence: No region sticker, box, or plug/voltage marking visible in photo 0.
No screenshot of the console's home screen or storage menu provided.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo of internal screws/seals or underside of the unit.
Requires a power-on/run test; not shown.
Rear/side ports not visible in photo 0.
Two controllers are visible in photo 0, but nothing confirms they are the original pads bundled from new rather than aftermarket or mismatched units.
No photo of a receipt was included.

claims.claim: 'I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true'
claims.evidence: Verbal assurance only, no new photo or video; seller's words are not proof per policy.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may fail to boot games despite 'neatly used' claim
risks.proof: Video clip of console powering on to the home screen and launching one installed game
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts

risks.risk: Ports (HDMI, power, USB) could be damaged or loose
risks.proof: Close-up photo of rear and side ports, plus a clip showing a cable plugged in and video output on a screen
risks.if_unproven: priced as ports unverified, treat as potentially faulty

risks.risk: Controllers could have analog stick drift or unresponsive buttons
risks.proof: Video of each controller connected and used in a game menu, showing stick and button response

risks.risk: Internal hardware (fan, HDD/SSD) could be worn or previously repaired, contradicting 'never opened or repaired'
risks.proof: Photo of the screws on the underside/back casing showing no tamper marks, plus a clip of the fan noise during use
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unverified, assume possible prior repair

risks.risk: Decal/skin on top could be hiding scratches, cracks, or stickers covering damage
risks.proof: Photo with the skin/decal peeled back or clear close-up of edges where skin meets casing
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic condition unknown, assume hidden wear

risks.risk: Claimed 'USA used' origin unverified; region can affect disc compatibility and resale value
risks.proof: Photo of the console's bottom serial/model sticker or original box

risks.risk: UK receipt claimed but not shown, so proof of purchase/authenticity is absent
risks.proof: Clear photo of the actual receipt with matching serial number
risks.if_unproven: priced as no proof of purchase

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on, reaching the home screen, and launching one of the 5 installed games
Close-up photo of the rear/side ports (HDMI, power, USB, Ethernet)
Photo of the bottom panel showing the serial/model sticker
Video of both controllers connected and tested (stick movement, all buttons, triggers)
Photo of the UK receipt with legible date and serial number
Photo of the top panel with the decal lifted or its edges shown clearly, to check for scratches underneath
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or video does not change the evidence on record; the claims remain unverifiable_remote and the item must still be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
